patch.value:
Clinical benefit ratio (CBR) is defined as the percentage of patients that achieve CR, PR, or stable disease for a minimum of four months. Patients will be evaluated for response by RECIST 1.1 and irRECIST.

Complete Response (CR)(RECIST1.1): All target lesions disappear. Any pathological lymph nodes must have a reduction in short axis to <10 mm.

Partial Response (PR)(RECIST1.1): At least a 30 % decrease in the sum of the longest diameters (LD) of target lesions, using the baseline sum as reference.

Stable Disease (SD)(RECIST1.1): Neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for PD, taking the smallest sum of diameters since treatment started as a reference irCR(irRECIST):Complete Resolution of non-nodal lesions and <10 mm short-axis for lymph nodes irPR(irRECIST): ≥30% decrease in tumor burden irSD(irRECIST): Does not meet criteria for irCR/irPR/irPD
From C1D1 up to a maximum of 31 months or until death
Safety Profile of Pembrolizumab Plus Fulvestrant
The toxicity profile will report all grade 3 and 4 toxicities as defined by the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (NCI CTCAE) v4
From C1D1 up to a maximum of 18 months or until death
From C1D1 up to a maximum of 33 months or until death

Durable response rate is defined as the number of months that a stable disease, partial or complete response per RECIST 1.1 is observed.

Complete Response (CR): All target lesions disappear. Any pathological lymph nodes must have a reduction in short axis to <10 mm.

Partial Response (PR): At least a 30 % decrease in the sum of the longest diameters (LD) of target lesions, using the baseline sum as reference.

Stable Disease (SD): Neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for PD, taking the smallest sum of diameters since treatment started as a reference
From C1D1 until death or up to a maximum of 31 months
From C1D1 up to a maximum of 44 months until death

adverseEventsModule.description:
Adverse events were recorded from the time of consent for at least 90 days after treatment discontinuation, per Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) v4.
Events were assessed at every visit at an interval of 21 days.

eventGroups.description:
Pembrolizumab 200 mg will be administered as a 30 minute IV infusion every 21 days. Sites should make every effort to target infusion timing to be as close to 30 minutes as possible. However, given the variability of infusion pumps from site to site, a window of -5 minutes and +10 minutes is permitted (i.e., infusion time is 30 minutes: -5 min/+10 min).

Fulvestrant 500 mg will be administered as two 5mL IM injections (one in each buttock). The standard dosing is as follows: Loading doses will be given on Cycle 1 Day 1 and 15. Thereafter, dosing will be every 4 weeks.

measures.description:
ECOG Performance Status :

Grade 0: Fully active; no limitations on daily activities. Grade 1: Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to perform light work.

Grade 2: Ambulatory and capable of all self-care; unable to work; up >50% of waking hours.

Grade 3: Capable of limited self-care; confined to bed/chair >50% of waking hours.

Grade 4: Completely disabled; totally confined to bed/chair. Grade 5: Dead.
